productBoundary.independentScenarioRule: A user or evaluator chooses an arbitrary prompt or input independently of the subsystem. The proof assesses transport, execution, identity, status and provenance, not whether an open-ended answer is factually correct.

gateDefinitions.core: The internal algorithm or mechanism has direct executable tests.
gateDefinitions.boundary: A versioned or explicit input/output boundary has positive and negative executable examples.
gateDefinitions.handoff: A real downstream consumer accepts the output without reconstructing, weakening or hiding it.
gateDefinitions.userDemo: A person can operate the representative capability with an independently chosen input and inspect the real result.
